content:
Cold canvassing involves contacting potential customers without prior introduction or relationship, which matches the description of making large numbers of unsolicited sales calls to unknown individuals.  

Multilevel marketing (A) focuses on recruiting others to sell products.  
The center-of-influence method (C) involves leveraging respected individuals to generate leads.  
The sales-associate method (D) typically refers to working with partners or colleagues in sales.  

Final answer: (B)
